visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In the initial phase, a young woman and a toddler girl sit on a colorful play mat in a bedroom. The mother wears a black t-shirt and the child wears a black Nike t-shirt and pink shorts with large Minnie Mouse ears. Behind them is a large white shelving unit filled with toys and a small toy house. (2) The scene cuts to a gray loft bed system where the child is lying under a patterned duvet. Large yellow text appears at the top. The bed features Paw Patrol character graphics on the safety rail. A matching gray desk and teal chair are positioned next to the bed structure. (3) The camera focuses on the child standing next to a built-in bookshelf at the end of the bed. She gestures toward various books and small toys including a yellow banana plush. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the clean wooden flooring and organized room layout. (4) The child opens large integrated drawers under the bed, revealing neatly folded colorful clothing. She points inside excitedly. The drawers are a matching gray matte finish. The camera uses a medium-close shot to emphasize the storage capacity of the furniture unit. (5) Transitioning to a play-focused segment, the child climbs a small ladder integrated into the bed frame. She wears a blue Paw Patrol-themed inflatable headband now. She begins jumping on the mattress with high energy while variety-style text '開心跳' pops up next to her. (6) In the final phase, the mother and child stand together by the bed waving at the camera. The mother wears reindeer antlers and the child holds a Peppa Pig plush. The video concludes with a wide shot of the entire bedroom set including a white wardrobe and an air conditioner.

(4) [Slogan]: 這組兒童床有兩款 我們選擇了桌櫃組 善用小坪數房型. (5) [Subtitle]: 媽媽在裡面裝了很多東西 不能進去!. (6) [Slogan]: 床底下的空間可以用來儲物 也可以讓小朋友當祕密基地唷. (7) [Subtitle]: 這裡是我的衣服. [Slogan]: 櫃子的容量非常的大 放整季的衣服都沒問題唷. (8) [Subtitle]: 這裡藏了很多玩具. [Slogan]: 很多貼心的儲物空間 真的是非常好用啊. (9) [Subtitle]: 帶你們去看我的床. (10) [Variety]: 開心跳. [Slogan]: 單人加大床型 非常適合陪睡 睡到成年也沒問題. (11) [Slogan]: 超喜歡這個床設計的高度 可以輕鬆站在床邊 陪伴孩子. visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The mother has short black hair and wears a black t-shirt and later reindeer antlers. The child has pigtails, wearing a black Nike t-shirt, pink shorts, and various decorative headbands (Minnie ears, Paw Patrol inflatable).

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A well-organized child's bedroom featuring a gray LEVANA loft bed system with integrated desk, drawers, and shelving. White toy cabinets, a toy house, books, plush toys, and a colorful alphabet play mat are visible.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming at approximately 115 BPM. A child's voice, characterized by high pitch and high arousal, excitedly introduces her room. The mix is clean with the vocal sitting prominently over the light percussion. (2) A sharp 'pop' sound effect signals a transition. An adult female voice enters with a warm, professional narrative tone, explaining the product details. The BGM remains consistent in tempo but features added light synth accents to maintain a playful atmosphere. (3) Throughout the middle section, the child's short, energetic interjections punctuate the mother's descriptive narration. Subtle 'ding' and 'whoosh' sound effects are synchronized with text overlays appearing on screen. The acoustic environment sounds like a treated indoor space. (4) As the child starts jumping, soft percussive 'thuds' are audible, indicating physical impact on the bed. These are integrated into the mix without overwhelming the music. The BGM gains a slightly higher energy with more prominent drum beats. (5) In the final phase, both voices overlap in a cheerful farewell. The music swells slightly in volume during the last few seconds before a clean fade-out. There is no audible distortion or significant background noise, suggesting high-quality post-production.
